integration.scope: Packaged actual Main low startup, injected focus-loss pause, backdrop/rain freeze and actual Resume button, GPU capture. Not OS focus delivery, whole pixel parity, full mission or performance.

precedence.scope: Actual Main isolated saved settings, explicit cold-quality priority and runtime quality signal. Menu signal tests apply behavior, not pointer click delivery.

controls.scope: Actual Main rich controls pane, three focusable header controls, injected Tab/ShiftTab/Escape and mouse wheel delivery, scroll-end GPU capture. Not whole browser layout or physical device test.

toggle.scope: Actual Main settings toggle: injected native mouse click and Space key, controller navigation/accept methods, live invertY setting, completed visual state and one GPU thumb color. Not physical controller or full-panel pixel parity.

ultra.scope: Original catalog materials, original mesh geometry/transforms and raw GPU mipchains in actual Main lighting. Full original pixel parity, query filtering and generated option variants remain open.

scope: Relocatable Linux development bundle from /tmp, isolated user data, pinned bundled engine. Six terminal-success GPU launches: default boot, low pause/resume, saved-quality precedence, rich controls wheel/focus, Ultra hero six mip hashes, invert toggle pointer/key/pad. External verification scripts load package res:// resources only. Not full visual fidelity, PCK production release or other-device qualification.
